shortDescription: Robinhood Chain's on-chain DEX daily trading volume reached $945 million on August 29, setting a record and surpassing the previous peak from mid-July. According to Odaily, DEX volume has rebounded from about $300 million in mid-August and has risen for several consecutive trading days recently.
